# ProGrafter

> UK trades marketplace connecting verified tradespeople with homeowners. No monthly fees — trades pay 7.5% only when a job completes, capped at £900 per job.

ProGrafter is built by Lee Palfreeman, a qualified electrician of 20 years. The platform handles job posting, verified quoting, stage-based payments, variation sign-off, an AI quote checker, and matching with green-energy grant schemes (ECO4, Boiler Upgrade Scheme, Warm Homes Plan).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, pricing, how it works, who it's for.

- [Quote Checker](/quote-checker): £9 AI-powered 43-point review of any building quote.
- [Green Grants](/green): Eligibility checker for UK green-energy grant schemes.
- [Checkatrade Alternative](/checkatrade-alternative): Side-by-side comparison vs Checkatrade pricing.

- [Planning Alerts](/planning-alerts): Local planning application alerts for trades.

- [Share Your Experience](/share-your-experience): Submit a testimonial.
